claim.quote: Our findings strongly disfavor the DAMA signal as originating from WIMP interactions, fully excluding DAMA/LIBRA 3$\sigma$ allowed regions and providing enhanced WIMP mass limits by an order of magnitude in the spin-independent model compared to previous results.

name: Limits on WIMP dark matter with NaI(Tl) crystals in three years of COSINE-100 data

summary.plain: With three years of data and the threshold lowered to 0.7 keV, COSINE-100 reports WIMP limits and says its findings strongly disfavour the DAMA signal as coming from WIMP interactions, fully excluding the DAMA/LIBRA three-sigma allowed regions.
summary.technical: Three years of COSINE-100 data, 0.7 keV threshold; no excess of WIMP-like events; spin-independent WIMP mass limits improved by an order of magnitude; spin-dependent limits for 0.1-5.0 GeV/c^2 and sub-GeV sensitivity via the Migdal effect (arXiv preprint, no journal reference in the abstract page).

title: Limits on WIMP dark matter with NaI(Tl) crystals in three years of COSINE-100 data
why_it_matters: States in the abstract that DAMA/LIBRA's three-sigma allowed regions are fully excluded under the WIMP interpretation.
